error: The analysis code writes the headline as a literal instead of reading the metrics registry; the number happens to be right.
warning_texts: No rule in audit/check_plan.json inspects how a claim value is produced: claims_recomputed compares the register with raw only for the current data, and claim_refs_resolve only confirms that a reference exists, so a claim value hardcoded to today's figure passed all 39 machine checks of gate_claims_

The audit_spec release rule against business-number literals covers only src/release/**; the claim builder under src/analysis is covered by no equivalent rule, so this class of defect is caught today only by an auditor reading the code.
summary: All five claim values recompute exactly from raw_data/orders.csv and equal the metrics registry, and each claim's population, period and caveats match how it was computed. But CLM-NET-REVENUE is not bound to its metric: src/analysis/build_claims.py line 53 writes its value as the string literal 35741.52 while declaring source_value_ref metrics.net_revenue.value, so the claim passes today only because the literal happens to equal the registry.
